name: openGear OG-X-FR 20-slot frame
notes: AJA-branded Ross OGX-FR: 2RU openGear frame, 20 card slots, two front-loading OG-X-PS supplies (500 W card power), two looping reference inputs (black burst, tri-level or AES DARS), fans in the front door. 483 x 427 x 90 mm, 9.1 kg with two PSUs. Rear modules cover two slots: full rear module = 1 card, split = 2 cards, double-wide = 4 slots. Check: rear position of the Ethernet, REF and power inlets (drawing fractions are estimates).

frame.controller: GFC-8322 frame controller in a dedicated slot; network card per frame option

name: OpenGear Converter SDI to Analog
source: Blackmagic OpenGear Converters manual (connection diagrams pp. 9-18); part numbers from dealer listings
notes: HD/SD-SDI to analog component, NTSC or PAL with redundant SDI input and loop. Analog or AES/EBU audio out. Blackmagic rear module supplied with the card. Fits 20-card 2RU openGear frames (OG3-FR, OGX-FR, DFR-8321). Check: rear module width assumed to be a full (2-slot) module, and port order on the module.

name: OpenGear Converter Analog to SDI
source: Blackmagic OpenGear Converters manual (connection diagrams pp. 9-18); part numbers from dealer listings
notes: Analog component/composite to HD/SD-SDI with analog or AES/EBU audio embedding. Blackmagic rear module supplied with the card. Fits 20-card 2RU openGear frames (OG3-FR, OGX-FR, DFR-8321). Check: rear module width assumed to be a full (2-slot) module, and port order on the module.

name: OpenGear Converter SDI to HDMI
source: Blackmagic OpenGear Converters manual (connection diagrams pp. 9-18); part numbers from dealer listings
notes: SDI to HDMI with embedded HDMI audio. Connectors are integrated with the card. Blackmagic rear module supplied with the card. Fits 20-card 2RU openGear frames (OG3-FR, OGX-FR, DFR-8321). Check: rear module width assumed to be a full (2-slot) module, and port order on the module.

name: OpenGear Converter HDMI to SDI
source: Blackmagic OpenGear Converters manual (connection diagrams pp. 9-18); part numbers from dealer listings
notes: HDMI (non copy protected) to SDI, both SDI outs carry the same signal. Blackmagic rear module supplied with the card. Fits 20-card 2RU openGear frames (OG3-FR, OGX-FR, DFR-8321). Check: rear module width assumed to be a full (2-slot) module, and port order on the module.

name: OpenGear Converter SDI to Audio
source: Blackmagic OpenGear Converters manual (connection diagrams pp. 9-18); part numbers from dealer listings
notes: De-embeds 4 ch analog or 8 ch AES/EBU (4 pairs) from SDI. Blackmagic rear module supplied with the card. Fits 20-card 2RU openGear frames (OG3-FR, OGX-FR, DFR-8321). Check: rear module width assumed to be a full (2-slot) module, and port order on the module.

name: OpenGear Converter Audio to SDI
source: Blackmagic OpenGear Converters manual (connection diagrams pp. 9-18); part numbers from dealer listings
notes: Embeds 4 ch analog or 8 ch AES/EBU (4 pairs) into SDI. Blackmagic rear module supplied with the card. Fits 20-card 2RU openGear frames (OG3-FR, OGX-FR, DFR-8321). Check: rear module width assumed to be a full (2-slot) module, and port order on the module.

name: OpenGear Converter Optical Fiber
source: Blackmagic OpenGear Converters manual (connection diagrams pp. 9-18); part numbers from dealer listings
notes: SDI to fibre and fibre to SDI, two independent directions. The LC fibre port is on a removable SFP at the card edge. Blackmagic rear module supplied with the card. Fits 20-card 2RU openGear frames (OG3-FR, OGX-FR, DFR-8321). Check: rear module width assumed to be a full (2-slot) module, and port order on the module.

name: OpenGear Converter Sync Generator
source: Blackmagic OpenGear Converters manual (connection diagrams pp. 9-18); part numbers from dealer listings
notes: Sync generator with 10 reference outputs (black burst / tri-level). Blackmagic rear module supplied with the card. Fits 20-card 2RU openGear frames (OG3-FR, OGX-FR, DFR-8321). Check: rear module width assumed to be a full (2-slot) module, and port order on the module.

name: OpenGear Converter UpDownCross
source: Blackmagic OpenGear Converters manual (connection diagrams pp. 9-18); part numbers from dealer listings
notes: Up, down and cross converter with 7 SDI outs. Check: the loop is passive (listed as "Passive Loop"). Blackmagic rear module supplied with the card. Fits 20-card 2RU openGear frames (OG3-FR, OGX-FR, DFR-8321). Check: rear module width assumed to be a full (2-slot) module, and port order on the module.

name: OpenGear Converter SDI Distribution
source: Blackmagic OpenGear Converters manual (connection diagrams pp. 9-18); part numbers from dealer listings
notes: 1 x 9 reclocking SDI distribution amplifier. No USB port. Blackmagic rear module supplied with the card. Fits 20-card 2RU openGear frames (OG3-FR, OGX-FR, DFR-8321). Check: rear module width assumed to be a full (2-slot) module, and port order on the module.

name: SRA-8901-10 12G-SDI DA 1x10
notes: 12G/6G/3G/HD/SD/MADI reclocking DA, 1 in, 10 non-inverting outs. Sold as SRA-8901-10-R3 with the full rear module.

name: SRA-8901-4 12G-SDI DA 1x4
notes: 12G/6G/3G/HD/SD/MADI reclocking DA, 1 in, 4 outs. Sold as SRA-8901-4-R3S: the split rear module serves this card and a second SRA-8901-4 in the next slot.

name: DRA-8902-10 dual 12G-SDI DA 2x10
source: Ross 8900 Series cut sheet; DRA-8902-10-R3 dealer listing
notes: Dual 12G/6G/3G/HD/SD/MADI reclocking DA, 2 in, 10 outs assignable to either input, or one DA with main/standby auto-failover. HD-BNC. OG3-FR and OGX-FR only. Sold as DRA-8902-10-R3.

name: DRA-8902-16 dual 12G-SDI DA 2x16
source: Ross 8900 Series cut sheet; DRA-8902-10-R3 dealer listing
notes: Dual 12G/6G/3G/HD/SD/MADI reclocking DA, 2 in, 16 outs assignable to either input, or one DA with main/standby auto-failover. HD-BNC. OG3-FR and OGX-FR only. Sold as DRA-8902-16-R3.

name: QRA-8808 quad 3G reclocking DA
notes: Four DAs on one card: channels 1-2 are 1x4, channels 3-4 are 1x3 (18 HD-BNCs). Out 1-4 = ch 1, 5-8 = ch 2, 9-11 = ch 3, 12-14 = ch 4. Check: output numbering per channel.

name: DRA-8804 dual 3G reclocking DA
notes: Dual 3G reclocking DA: dual 1x4 with -R2, dual 1x8 with -R2H, or a single 1x16 with A/B input failover.

name: UDC-8625A 3G/HD/SD up/down/cross converter
source: Ross UDC-8625A-A and UDC-8625A-B cut sheets
notes: Multi-function 3G/HD/SD format converter with frame sync, ARC, keyer and logo inserter. SDI In 1-2 have full frame sync. The 8 AES ports are set as 8 in, 4 in/4 out or 8 out (needs the audio daughter card). -A card = 75 ohm (R2H/R2D), -B card = 110 ohm (R2B). The card also has 4 GPI/O, an RS-232/485 port and 10/100 Ethernet. Check: which of these are on the rear module and their connectors.

name: MUX-8258-A 8 ch AES embedder (75 ohm)
source: MUX-8258 dealer listings (10-BNC rear module: 1 SDI in, 1 SDI out, 8 AES in)
notes: Embeds 8 AES/EBU inputs (75 ohm) into HD/SD-SDI.

name: DMX-8259-A 8 ch AES de-embedder (75 ohm)
notes: De-embeds 8 AES/EBU outputs (75 ohm) from 3G/HD/SD-SDI. Check: SDI in/out count on the 10-connector module (assumed 1 in, 1 out like MUX-8258).

name: MUX-8258-B 8 ch AES embedder (110 ohm)
source: MUX-8258 dealer listings (10-BNC rear module: 1 SDI in, 1 SDI out, 8 AES in)
notes: Embeds 8 AES/EBU inputs (110 ohm) into HD/SD-SDI. Check: WECO vs BNC split on the R2B module.

name: DMX-8259-B 8 ch AES de-embedder (110 ohm)
notes: De-embeds 8 AES/EBU outputs (110 ohm) from 3G/HD/SD-SDI. Check: SDI in/out count on the 10-connector module (assumed 1 in, 1 out like MUX-8258).

name: ADA-8402-A AES/EBU DA (75 ohm)
notes: Reclocking AES-3id DA: 1 in, 4 outs with the split module or 8 with the full module. 2 W. Check: R2A full module part number (listings name R2B for the 110 ohm card).

name: ADA-8402-B AES/EBU DA (110 ohm)
notes: Reclocking balanced AES3 DA: 1 in, 8 outs with the full module or 4 with the split module. Check: connector type (WECO terminal assumed).

name: SPG-8260 sync pulse generator
notes: Sync generator: output pairs 1A-4A / 1B-4B each set to tri-level, black burst or colour bars; 48 kHz AES reference and AES tone. Locks to frame REF 1/2, its own ref input or internal. SPG-8260-W adds word clock. Check: which outputs the split module keeps.

Ext Ref In / AES Ref Out

name: SHC-8932-F dual 12G-SDI/fibre to HDMI converter
notes: Low-latency dual UHD SDI or fibre to HDMI converter. Check: SDI connector type (HD-BNC assumed).

name: AMX-8952 12G embedder/de-embedder, frame sync
notes: 4K UHD 12G-SDI audio embedder/de-embedder and frame synchroniser. -C version: 8 balanced analog channels on a pluggable terminal block. -B version uses R3B-8952. Check: SDI in/out split of the 3 HD-BNCs, and analog in/out split.

name: DAC-8418-A dual AES to quad analog audio
notes: Converts 2 unbalanced AES inputs to 4 balanced analog outputs. Check: connector types.

name: HDC-8223 HD monitoring down converter and DA
notes: 2 in (manual or auto failover), 4 outs each set to SDI or analog composite with HD down conversion, optional analog audio out. Check: connector allocation on the 10 BNC module.

name: OG-3GDA-2x4 3G-SDI DA (2x4 or 1x8)
notes: Reclocking 3G-SDI DA, two 1x4 DAs (In 1 to Out 1-4, In 2 to Out 5-8) or one 1x8 (In 2 unused). Two slots per card, 10 BNC rear module included. Check: AJA spec table says 2 outs per DA while the overview says 4; drawn as 8 outs total.

name: OG-FiDO-TR 3G-SDI fibre single-mode transceiver
notes: 3G-SDI/fibre single-mode transceiver, LC connectors. Occupies two frame slots. -MM multimode versions have the same connectors.

name: OG-FiDO-T 3G-SDI fibre single-mode transmitter
notes: 3G-SDI/fibre single-mode transmitter, LC connectors. Occupies two frame slots. -MM multimode versions have the same connectors.

name: OG-FiDO-R 3G-SDI fibre single-mode receiver
notes: 3G-SDI/fibre single-mode receiver, LC connectors. Occupies two frame slots. -MM multimode versions have the same connectors. Out 2 on R models is inverting (not DVB-ASI compatible).

name: OG-FiDO-2T 3G-SDI fibre dual single-mode transmitter
notes: 3G-SDI/fibre dual single-mode transmitter, LC connectors. Occupies two frame slots. -MM multimode versions have the same connectors.

name: OG-FiDO-2R 3G-SDI fibre dual single-mode receiver
notes: 3G-SDI/fibre dual single-mode receiver, LC connectors. Occupies two frame slots. -MM multimode versions have the same connectors. Out 2 on R models is inverting (not DVB-ASI compatible).

name: 9904-UDX-4K 12G UHD up/down/cross converter, frame sync
notes: UHD/HD/3G up/down/cross converter and frame sync, 12G single wire or quad 3G, embed/de-embed, HDR options. Up to 5 per OG3/HPF-9000 frame, 7 per oGx frame; leave 1RU above the frame. Variants -IP (2 x 10GigE) and -DSP use the same rear modules. Check: specs marked preliminary by Cobalt.

rearModules.name: Double width
rearModules.notes: Card sits in the even slot and consumes the adjacent odd slot. Cannot be fitted in slots 19/20.

rearModules.name: Rear module
rearModules.notes: Mates to card in odd slot. Check: width and SFP count.

rearModules.name: Rear module
rearModules.notes: Relay-protected out passes SDI In 5 on power loss. Mates to card in odd slot. Check: width.

name: 9902-2UDX dual 3G up/down/cross converter, frame sync
notes: Two independent 3G/HD/SD paths: up/down/cross conversion, frame sync, audio embed/de-embed. Many more RM20-9902-2UDX rear modules exist (D, F, H, J, K, L, M/S): add them in the catalogue editor if needed.

rearModules.name: Standard width
rearModules.notes: SDI In 1-2 have independent relay bypass.
